# citrix_resource_access_policy (Resource)

Manages a site-wide resource access policy. A resource access policy restricts access to the published resources that carry a tag, are of a resource type, or both, across all delivery groups, based on the SmartAccess tags of the user's connection.

For a user to gain access to a resource through a policy, their connection must match all of its enabled include criteria and none of its enabled exclude criteria.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Only allow access to applications tagged with the tag from connections through the corporate gateway
resource "citrix_resource_access_policy" "example_tag_and_type_policy" {
    name          = "Example Resource Access Policy"
    description   = "Restrict tagged applications to the corporate gateway"
    tag_id        = citrix_tag.example_tag.id
    resource_type = "Application"

    enable_criteria_for_include_connections = true
    include_connections_criteria_type       = "MatchAny"
    include_criteria_filters = [
        {
            filter_name  = "CorpGateway"
            filter_value = "CorpVPN"
        }
    ]
}

# Deny access to all desktops from connections matching the untrusted network filter
resource "citrix_resource_access_policy" "example_type_policy" {
    name          = "Example Desktop Resource Access Policy"
    resource_type = "Desktop"

    enable_criteria_for_exclude_connections = true
    exclude_criteria_filters = [
        {
            filter_name  = "CorpGateway"
            filter_value = "UntrustedNetwork"
        }
    ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the resource access policy. Must be unique within the site.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the resource access policy. Defaults to an empty string.
- `enable_criteria_for_exclude_connections` (Boolean) Whether to enable the criteria for exclude connections. When enabled, `exclude_criteria_filters` must be specified. Defaults to `false`.
- `enable_criteria_for_include_connections` (Boolean) Whether to enable the criteria for include connections. When enabled, `include_connections_criteria_type` and `include_criteria_filters` must be specified. Defaults to `false`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the resource access policy is enabled. A disabled policy is not considered when evaluating resource access. Defaults to `true`.
- `exclude_criteria_filters` (Attributes List) The SmartAccess filters which deny access to a connection that matches any of them. Can only be specified when `enable_criteria_for_exclude_connections` is `true`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--exclude_criteria_filters))
- `include_connections_criteria_type` (String) Whether a connection must match all (`MatchAll`) or any (`MatchAny`) of the `include_criteria_filters` to be granted access. Can only be specified when `enable_criteria_for_include_connections` is `true`. Choose between `MatchAny` and `MatchAll`.
- `include_criteria_filters` (Attributes List) The SmartAccess filters a connection must match to be granted access. Can only be specified when `enable_criteria_for_include_connections` is `true`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--include_criteria_filters))
- `metadata` (Attributes List) Metadata for the Resource Access Policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `resource_type` (String) Type of resource the policy applies to. At least one of `tag_id` and `resource_type` must be specified. Choose between `Application`, `Desktop`, and `Content`.

~> **Please Note** Removing `resource_type` forces the policy to be replaced.
- `tag_id` (String) GUID identifier of the tag whose resources the policy applies to. At least one of `tag_id` and `resource_type` must be specified.

~> **Please Note** Removing `tag_id` forces the policy to be replaced.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the resource access policy.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Resource Access Policy can be imported by specifying the policy Id
terraform import citrix_resource_access_policy.example_tag_and_type_policy 1
```
